result:
Done. PR #163 is ready, branch clean, working tree clean.

## What landed

A lane is now **a branch with an open PR**, not a branch named `lane/*`. All four gaps closed:

- **`arms.sh`** collects from master + every open-PR branch + (still) every `lane/*` branch, fetching PR heads by name; `pr_for()` has no prefix test. `lane.remote`'s predictions were never collected before — the device pipeline had never once been available to it.
- **`fleet.py`** counts a PR on any branch a territory row names, and reports remote lanes under a new `REMOTE LANES` section instead of listing them as claims with no agent.
- **`handback.sh`** names the lane and its routine instead of "whoever owns this branch".
- **`lane.sh`** refuses `start` *and* `resume` for a remote lane — the two-agents-one-branch hazard, guarded at both doors.
- **`fold.sh`** exempts a remote lane's branch from the prune (target narrowed, never widened).

One marker, `remote` on a territory row, read by one new helper. Its **value is the branch**, not `true`: two consumers are handed a branch and must find the lane, which a boolean can't answer. A board it can't read is a refusal in `lane.sh`, a kept ref in `fold.sh` — not a silent "no remote lanes".

**41 new checks, all green**; 25 fail against master's code (verified by running the fragment inside an unpacked master tree). The 16 that don't are must-not-move legs, negative halves of pairs, and two regression guards — each named in NOTES with why.

## Two things I got wrong

The first version made `arms.sh state` — documented read-only — call gh, putting a warning ahead of the `STATE=` line; `94-arms-label-state.sh` caught it. And `git add -A` swept 504 verification-scratch files plus a 4 MB tar into the branch; I rebuilt from `origin/master` with only the eight intended paths and force-pushed.

## Two blockers that are not this lane's

- **`86-fold-regressed.sh` is red on master** and CI is the gate of record, so every fold waits — including this one. `a4fcced05a` made a fold delete the lane branch's *local* head; `4eb641e777` then added a fixture whose `fr_reset` re-pushes that branch. One line in the fixture fixes it, in `lane.foldregress`'s file, not `fold.sh`.
- **`preflight.sh` fails only on `coverage`**, for unclassified issue #164. Every other gate including `territory` is green. `--allow-tracker` does *not* clear this one.

Board request (no `[lane.laneshape]` row exists; five of my files are held by other rows) is in NOTES and posted on the PR — the documented `$DISPATCH_DIR/board-requests/` channel turns out not to be writable from a lane worktree at all.
